summary: Read an array that is already known to rise and then fall. Its length is from 3 to 10000. Each entry is an integer from 0 to 1000000. Values climb strictly until a single crest, then drop strictly all the way to the end. The crest is neither the first entry nor the last entry. Write the index of that crest. Indexes begin at 0. There is exactly one such crest in the whole array.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
